It can be found that the Nb containing TiAl-based alloy has the highest values of both ﬂexural strength and fracture toughness. In particular, it exhibits fracture toughness two times that of the monolithic TiAl-based alloy.
In case of TiAl–Nb–Mo–Cr alloy, where a part of Nb is replaced by Mo and Cr, both the strength and fracture toughness decrease slightly.
